title: WooCommerce detected
question: Is this a WooCommerce store?
method: Informational. Detect wc/store in the REST index, a woocommerce body class or a WooCommerce generator meta tag. The result selects the profile; it is never scored.

title: Store API reachable
question: Can an agent read products through the Store API without credentials?
method: GET /wp-json/wc/store/v1/products?per_page=1. Pass on 200 with a JSON array; fail on 401, 403, 404 or a non-JSON body.

title: Store API not rate-limited for reads
question: Do a few sequential Store API reads succeed?
method: Three sequential product list requests. Fail on any 429 or 5xx; warn when a Retry-After header appears.

title: Store API product completeness
question: Do Store API products carry the fields an agent needs?
method: Sampled products must carry name, prices, images, stock status, permalink and categories. Pass when all do; warn when some lack images or categories; fail when prices or stock status are missing.

title: Public product feed discoverable
question: Is there a product feed an agent can find without being told its URL?
method: Look for links in llms.txt, robots.txt, the sitemap or a rel=alternate link tag pointing at a Google, Meta, ACP or OpenAI-style feed (XML, CSV, JSON). Pass when one is found and fetchable.

spec.title: Google Merchant Center product data specification

title: Feed freshness
question: Was the feed updated recently?
method: Read Last-Modified on the feed response or a timestamp inside the feed. Pass within 24 hours; warn within 7 days; fail beyond.

title: Catalog in sitemap matches Store API
question: Do the sitemap and the Store API agree on catalog size?
method: Compare the product URL count in the sitemap with the X-WP-Total header of the Store API product list. Pass within 10 percent; warn within 25 percent; fail beyond.
